# Signing In and Out at the Till

**There is no idle logout.** The till will not sign anyone out for being left alone, however long it sits there. If staff are finding themselves back at the PIN screen, something else is going on, and this article covers what.

---

## What keeps you signed in

Once a staff member signs in with their PIN, they stay signed in through all of this:

* the app being closed and reopened
* the tablet being restarted
* the **Update** button, or the update banner
* the tablet putting the app to sleep in the background

This matters most on iPads, which clear apps out of memory in the background when they need the space. That used to send staff back to the PIN screen at apparently random moments. It no longer does.

---

## What signs you out

Only three things.

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Log out** in the staff menu | Immediate. The intended way to hand the till to the next person. |
| **Eight hours** after signing in | A fixed limit from the moment of sign-in, not an idle timer. It applies whether the till has been busy or untouched, and there is no setting to change it. |
| **The server ending the session** | Uncommon — for example if the staff member's PIN access has been withdrawn. |

When a session ends by itself, the PIN screen explains why rather than leaving staff guessing — either **Your session ended after 8 hours — sign in again** or **Your session has ended — sign in again**.

Logging out deliberately shows no message.

---

## Settings asks for the PIN separately

The **Settings** screen has its own PIN check, and it is deliberately stricter: it asks every time you open Settings, again after any reload, and again after five minutes of sitting in there untouched.

That's a second lock on the admin area, not a sign of anything wrong. Being signed in to the till doesn't get you into Settings without the PIN.

---

## Good to know

* **Log out at the end of a shift.** The till stays signed in as whoever used it last, right through a restart. If the next person doesn't log out and back in, their sales are credited to the previous staff member until the eight hours run out.
* **Re-pairing the till signs everyone out.** If you re-pair the terminal on the Setup screen, the next person has to sign in with their PIN. That's intended.
* **A black screen is not a logout.** If the screen has gone dark, that's the screensaver — tap it and carry on. See **The Till Screensaver**.
